specs.title: UIR33-01-A1 the running cultivation stage replaces new-plan controls with real pause and original-budget keyboard continuation
UIR33-01-A2 assisted identity actual spending and finite limits survive readonly plan inspection refresh and explicit takeover
UIR33-01-A3 a failed cycle exposes the canonical retry while viewing the next draft cannot replace the accepted command
UIR33-01-A4 the stage pause during a held atomic save settles only that cycle without starting another
UIR33-01-A5 another cave activity keeps its real name controls and authorization instead of a disabled cultivation draft
